answer: The nonce chain allows at most 2 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own willow record, and its own share of the lagoon quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The saffron ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 4035 identities would post 1595 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
